label: Analysis
definition: Engineering or data analysis (calculation, trend, model, dependency graph)

label: Document review
definition: Examination of approved documents, drawings, studies and records

definition: Questioning competent persons; corroboration required for technical claims

label: Inspection
definition: Physical or logical examination of an asset, configuration or installation
